subject.title: fix(preflight): rebaseline integrity after toolchain setup

question: Should external merge preflight accept a post-toolchain local Git config baseline when the only setup-time change is core.hooksPath=git-hooks?
rationale: The patch is mechanically focused and covered, but it intentionally changes an integrity-sensitive boundary for autonomous merge preflight, so maintainer intent is needed before merge.

options.title: Accept constrained baseline
options.body: Merge once the draft is ready, treating the exact core.hooksPath=git-hooks setup change as an intentional toolchain effect while blocking all later config drift.

options.title: Require live preflight proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted transcript from the external preflight scenario named in the PR body before accepting the boundary change.

options.title: Keep pre-toolchain strictness
options.body: Reject the baseline shift and require target setup to avoid writing local Git config during preflight.

recommendation.title: Accept constrained baseline
recommendation.body: Merge once the draft is ready, treating the exact core.hooksPath=git-hooks setup change as an intentional toolchain effect while blocking all later config drift.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc owns the recent history for this exact preflight integrity path and authored the follow-up tightening commit.
